fabricated_details: Production flow resumed without further interruption
Monitor the scanner for the next 2-3 hours to confirm stability
Log the recalibration event in the equipment maintenance record
Review the master part calibration schedule and consider a brief refresher
Report any recurrence immediately to maintenance and quality control

rationale: The report captures all details from the supervisor input accurately in terms of the issue itself, but invents an extensive timeline, specific follow-up actions, operational statuses, and procedural recommendations not present in the input. It fails to flag the missing cause of the calibration drift, presenting the event as completely resolved without uncertainty handling. Despite its clean structure and scannability, the volume of fabricated details heavily penalizes its accuracy.
